body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented ''SPH-B5600'', a white colored DMB phone which swivels to a horizontal position for video viewing. It features a 2M swiveling camera, Bluetooth networking, 2.2-inch QVGA LCD and TV-out. It also has a microSD external memory card slot and a hot key for VOD/MOD/MP3 playback on the top. Other features include mobile banking service with a built-in chip slot, black GUI, "playing with my pet”, “my screen function” and more.
